 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Hektic'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Hectic'.**
 
• The word '**Hectic**' is an **adjective** which means 'full of incessant or frantic activity'. **(उत्साहपूर्ण या व्यस्त)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• The day was hectic as we had back-to-back meetings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'Hektic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Gentle -** having or showing a mild, kind, or tender temperament or character **(सौम्य)**
 
• **Brillant -** Misspelled. The correct spelling is 'Brilliant', meaning 'exceptionally clever or talented' **(प्रतिभाशाली)**
 
• **Kinetic -** relating to or resulting from motion **(गतिज)**
